item.title: Community advocate speaks out after 17-year-old hospitalized in East End shooting
item.description: A 17-year-old was shot Tuesday night in Richmond's East End, raising concerns about ongoing violence in the old Creighton Court as the city works to revitalize the area.

item.title: Memorial games will honor young basketball star Jaylen Martinez
item.description: It's been almost a year since Jaylen Martinez, a promising basketball star, died in an accidental shooting. Now, his mother and basketball community are working to ensure his name and mission live on.

item.title: VCU defeats La Salle 77-68
item.description: Lazar Djokovic's 26 points helped VCU defeat La Salle 77-68 on Wednesday night. The Rams extended their winning streak to eight games.
